statement: For the exact two-color Permutation Wordle game at n=3 frozen in source.md and interpreted in problem.md, the optimal deterministic success counts are (N_1,N_2,N_3,N_4,N_5,N_6)=(1,8,24,40,47,48), and N_r=48 for every r>=6. The Kutin--Smithline multicolor CircularShift algorithm, read by its circuit-completion prose, Figure 6, and the proof of Lemma 4.4 in arXiv:2408.00903v3, has exact-round counts (1,7,16,16,7,1) and therefore attains N_r simultaneously for every r>=1. The displayed color-update cases in Definition 4.3 conflict with those parts of the primary source; this claim uses the exact operational interpretation documented in evidence/circular-shift-interpretation.md and does not assert that the inconsistent displayed cases literally produce the same strategy.
contribution: A complete computer-assisted resolution of the frozen 48-secret finite claim: an unpruned exact Bellman census with an independently implemented every-action replay certificate, together with an independent 48-secret CircularShift transcript census and replay. The result is restricted to (n,s)=(3,2); it does not resolve the general multicolor conjecture, and priority is provisional because the cited 2026 source mentions unavailable work in preparation.
